name: k6-api-performance-suite
description: Production-grade, open-source-ready Performance & API Testing Suite using Grafana k6 and Newman

scripts.test:api: newman run collections/fintech-api.collection.json -e environments/local.json --reporters cli,json --reporter-json-export reports/newman-results.json
scripts.test:api:staging: newman run collections/fintech-api.collection.json -e environments/staging.json --reporters cli,json --reporter-json-export reports/newman-staging-results.json
scripts.test:api:html: newman run collections/fintech-api.collection.json -e environments/local.json --reporters cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/newman-report.html
scripts.test:all: npm run test:api && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:load
